subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@acme.com>, Greg Thompson <gthompson@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Per our call, I wanted to recap the agreed mutual action plan (MAP), confirm owners/timelines, and surface a couple of open items so we stay aligned. I attached the initial MAP workbook and the pricing proposal for reference.

Quick summary of what we heard (pain & goals):
- Pain: High per-token inference costs and unpredictable tail latency for peak reporting workloads (esp. end-of-month dashboards).
- Goal: Reduce inference unit cost by ~40% for embedding & generation workflows while preserving 99th percentile latency SLAs for interactive admin tooling.
- Risk: Procurement/legal timeline may push decision window into late May unless we accelerate the SOW and procurement packet.

Decision process & stakeholders (as discussed):
- Executive sponsor: Tom Reynolds (SaaS Ops) — final approver for budget.
- Technical reviewer: Sara Li (Platform Eng) — validates performance & security fit.
- Procurement/Legal: Greg Thompson — handles contract & PO.
- Internal Redwood owners: Marissa Cole (AE), Rishi Malhotra (AM), Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer).

Proposed MAP milestones (dates tentative — please confirm):
1) Technical deep-dive + demo (proof-of-concept scope) — week of May 10 (owner: Dev Patel).
2) Procurement packet & pricing finalization — target May 12 (owner: Marissa Cole).
3) Contract review (legal) & PO issuance — target May 20 (owner: Greg Thompson / Redwood Legal).
4) Pilot/kickoff (Dedicated capacity) — target June 1 (owner: Sara Li / Redwood Delivery).

Open items / asks:
- Tom/Greg: Can procurement commit to reviewing the packet by May 12 if we share the SOW on May 6?
- Sara: Please confirm the two key performance scenarios you want us to validate in the PoC (1. 1k qps streaming inference; 2. batch embedding for nightly reports with 100k records).
- Everyone: Please review the attached MAP workbook and let me know edits to owners or dates.

Attachments: Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP table), redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf (pricing bands and reserved capacity options)

Next step I propose: schedule the technical deep-dive on May 11 or 12. I can coordinate a 60-minute session with Dev and your platform team. Please reply with preferred times or confirm the high-level milestones above.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
